reasoning: The informal statement asks for a counterexample showing that the interior of a connected set need not be connected. The correction supplies one in ℝ×ℝ. The original instead universally quantifies over every topological space X and asks for such a counterexample in each X, so it is stronger and false: a singleton space has no connected set with disconnected interior. The root cause is misunderstanding the quantifiers in an instruction to exhibit one counterexample, not omitting a hypothesis from the intended theorem.
